name: fMRIPrep - Surface Output - ICA-AROMA
summary: Preprocesses BOLD fMRI with fMRIPrep 21.0.1 and outputs surface time series (GIFTI and CIFTI) on fsaverage or fsnative surfaces, confound regressors, brain masks and an HTML report.
description: Fork of the brainlife fMRIPrep surface App that runs fMRIPrep 21.0.1 with a FreeSurfer input and maps the surface-space BOLD outputs (left/right GIFTI, 91k CIFTI dtseries and, for fsnative, the surface vertices) to brainlife datatypes. Needs a T1w, a raw BOLD and the FreeSurfer output of the same T1w. Although the App lists an ICA-AROMA output, this configuration has no aroma parameter, so ICA-AROMA is never enabled and that output stays empty.

inputs.description: t1 anatomy to register the input fmri data. Please be sure to use the same t1 used to generate the freesurfer input.
inputs.requirements: Must be the same T1w used to generate the FreeSurfer input.

inputs.description: freesurfer output used to aid preprocessing
Optional T2-weighted image of the same subject, converted into the BIDS input given to fMRIPrep.
2phasemag fieldmap is not yet supported by fmriprep (https://github.com/poldracklab/sdcflows/issues/15) - testing 1.5.2 should should support it.

outputs.description: fMRIPrep confounds time series (regressors.tsv and its JSON sidecar).
preprocessed t1 (same alignment as the original t1, but level adjusted - editme)
Brain mask of the preprocessed T1w in the original T1w space.
Preprocessed BOLD time series on the left and right hemisphere surfaces (GIFTI func.gii) in the selected surface space.
surface vertices. only meaningful for fsnative.

parameters.description: Surface output space for the BOLD time series: fsaverage5, fsaverage6 or the subject's native FreeSurfer surface (fsnative).
Skip the BIDS validation of input data. Try this option if your data is not BIDS compatible but you'd like to go ahead and process it through fmriprep anyway.

citations.text: Esteban O. et al. fMRIPrep: a robust preprocessing pipeline for functional MRI. Nature Methods 16, 111-116 (2019).

failure_modes.message: app needs minimally a T1w and fmri. exiting
failure_modes.fix: Provide both a T1w and an fMRI input.

failure_modes.cause: The FreeSurfer license is not available on the compute resource.
failure_modes.fix: Set FREESURFER_LICENSE in the environment of the resource running the App.
